messages:
Nora P.: Heads-up: after the scorecard template migration this morning, several interviewers reported missing Likert scales and the technical section mapping is wrong for job BE-42.
Diego M.: Confirmed. Our template ID map got shifted during the CSV import; template_v21 columns misaligned -> questions mapping to wrong fields.
Casey (recruiter): Uh oh. I already have 5 interviewers who've submitted scores and one form looks like it saved answers into the "culture fit" field instead of "architecture".
ops-bot: [automated] import_job:scorecard_templates -> finished with warnings: 5 rows skipped, 2 mappings ambiguous.
Ravi S.: Priority: freeze template publishing and don't allow edits until we reconcile. Can we roll back to backup from 03/12? Also need affected candidate IDs.
Nora P.: Case list: IC-5512 (panel 09:00), IC-5513 (10:30), IC-5520 (13:00), IC-5527 (15:00), IC-5530 (16:30). Some already have partial submissions.
Diego M.: I'll run a diff between pre-migration dump and current templates, then run a migration fix script to remap columns correctly. I will also export a CSV of submissions for the affected interviews so we can manually fix values if needed.
Casey (recruiter): Please flag any submissions that changed field names so we can contact interviewers to verify if they recall scores. We need to avoid data loss for hiring decisions.
Ravi S.: Actionable: 1) Diego run fix + export submissions CSV; 2) Nora lock template publishing and notify recruiters; 3) Casey draft quick note to interviewers asking to re-check forms where mismatched; 4) Ops add template-versioning & preview feature.
ops-bot: [automated] ticket created: OPS-3241 "scorecard-template-migration-fix" assigned to Diego M., priority P1.
Diego M.: Started fix. Will post results and upload exports to /shared/people-ops/template-migration/1745011111-export.csv
Nora P.: Also let's schedule a short interviewer refresher on scorecard changes next Tue. Casey can draft 10-min notes for interviewers + link to training recording.
Casey (recruiter): Will do. Drafting note now. Suggest we include screenshots of where to find the saved score fields to make verification easy.
Ravi S.: Long-term: add template preview, validation step before publish, and a CI check for CSV imports to detect column shifts.
Nora P.: Thanks everyone. Please follow up here when exports & fix are done. We'll pause any hiring decisions relying on these scorecards until verified.
